diagnosis: Check C4 is leaking because it relies on a boolean requirement (certificate_of_conformance_required) that the model satisfies by defaulting to high-compliance/cautionary behavior. Even without access to PF3, the lone decision-maker correctly identifies that quarantined material requires formal documentation, making the check satisfiable through generic professional heuristics rather than the specific hidden portal requirement.

C4.why: The customer portal requirement changes release from ordinary receiving approval to requiring a signed Certificate of Conformance and a corresponding release commitment.
